evaluation: Use all 43 overlapping past windows and full 123-company cohort. Compare the same market-only covariance with independent sector factors and joint sector covariance, all with original marginal stock variance retained. Five size-preserving deterministic membership permutations are controls, not independent historical replications or p-values. Check own-company inclusion against leave-one-out sector exposure, exact group remainder sum identities, full matrices, positive semidefiniteness and unmodeled factors. No model/default selection.
identities: Own-sector OLS makes its own factor orthogonal to each fitted company remainder, not every other sector factor. Self-included sector means impose sum(gamma)=sector size and sum(remainders)=0. On modeled companies, full joint-sector covariance already carries the aggregate residual series, so adding independent company remainder diagonals raises portfolio variance by their sum divided by company count squared. This is a diagnostic of self-inclusion, not proof that real company risk is absent.
interpretation: Exploratory source-only decomposition on the repeatedly consumed 2019 cohort selected retrospectively by 2020 QA activity. The 2019Q3 official classification was retrieved in 2026 and lacks certification of its original first-release bytes; date proxy is conservative, not a precise release time. Industry means include the target stock and joint industry covariance is high-dimensional relative to 20 observations. Numerical identities, covariance fit and shuffled-label comparisons do not establish causal sector shocks, forecast performance, unseen-period validation, real investor calibration, any new auction or semantic-gate release. Preserve all earlier failures and inactive exposures.
missingness: Missing industry labels and zero benchmark variance fail. Singleton or zero-variance industry factor exposures and undefined leave-one-out exposures remain null; original market residual risk is explicitly retained for unmodeled factors in this source-only comparison. No coefficient is filled zero and no output may drive an agent.
